blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
blocks.zh: 矢量量化(VQ),特别是基于lattice的方法,为低位大语言模型(LLMs)提供了强大的速率扭曲权衡,然而他们在量化-意识训练(VQ-QAT)下的行为仍然不易理解. 我们把拉蒂斯 VQ-QAT 放大到十亿参数的 LLMs 和数十亿托肯的训练系统, 并引入 SQuAT,一种形状增益 VQ-QAT 方法, 训练了单独的直通计算器, 用于形状和收益 。 SQAT将权重分解为方向和量级: 归正方向使用$E_8元衍生的球形代码簿进行量子化,而增益则用低位的阶梯量子独立进行量子化. 我们显示,与适用于全量子的标准STE(它忽略了形状增益结构)不同,这些单独的STE会诱导正切空间更新方向,产生一种隐含的球形(Riemannian)优化形式. 为了实现可扩展性,我们开发了一个分布式的精确近邻分配计划,其中工人对离散重块进行定量,只交流离散指数,将VQ-QAT培训时间缩短了12.8美元\时间,并允许我们将其扩大为10B令牌. 纵观指令调制LLaMA-32-1B/3B,Quen3-4B,以及基础的Quen3-1.7B,SQuAT在相同的量子和初始化下,一贯超越标准VQ-QAT STE,实现SOTA VQ-QAT精度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) contain billions of parameters ( Touvron et al., 2023a ; Touvron et al., 2023b ) , making weight storage and movement a dominant bottleneck for inference.
Even with INT8 or INT4 formats, memory bandwidth remains a limitation for token generation, so aggressive quantization is critical to reduce footprint, while preserving quality ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)包含数十亿参数(Touvron等人,2023a;Touvron等人,2023b),使重量存储和移动成为推论的主要瓶颈.
即使采用INT8或INT4格式,内存带宽仍然对符号生成有限制,因此积极的量化对于减少足迹至关重要,同时保持质量(Frantar等人,2023年;Lin等人,2024年;Shao等人,2023年).

blocks.en:
Most practical LLM quantization pipelines rely on integer scalar quantization.
However, recent methods have demonstrated that vector quantization (VQ) can offer superior quality–compression trade-offs by quantizing groups of weights jointly ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Van Baalen et al., 2024 ; Egiazarian et al., 2024 ) , especially at very low bit-widths.
While general VQ requires codebooks that grow exponentially with quantization dimensionality, Structured VQ methods based on lattices ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) , trellises ( Tseng et al., 2024b ) , or pyramid constructions ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ) avoid storing explicit codebooks.
Some methods ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ; van der Ouderaa et al., 2026 ) decompose weight vectors into shape (direction) and gain (magnitude), motivated by the observation that distortion is often dominated by angular error, while block norms can be represented with fewer bits ( Sabin and Gray, 1982 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
大多数实用的LLM量化管道都依赖于整数scalar量化.
然而,最近的方法表明,矢量定量(VQ)可以提供更高的质量——通过对重量群进行定量的权衡取舍(Zhang等人,2025年;Van Baalen等人,2024年;Egiazarian等人,2024年),特别是在极低的位宽。
虽然一般的VQ需要与定量维度成指数增长的编码本,但是基于latices(Tseng等人,2024a), trellises(Tseng等人,2024b),或金字塔构造(van der Ouderaa等人,2024)的结构化VQ方法避免存储明确的编码本.
一些方法(van der Ouderaa等人,2024年;van der Ouderaa等人,2026年)将重量矢量分解为形状(方向)和增益(宽度),其动机是观察到扭曲往往以角错为主,而块规范可以用更少的比特表示(Sabin and Gray,1982年;Yue等人,2025年).

Quantization-aware training (QAT) for LLMs with carefully chosen low-bit quantizers and sufficient training budget can retain strong model quality ( Panferov et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
While some work on QAT for VQ exists (e.g., Wang et al. (2026) ; Malinovskii et al. (2024) ), VQ-QAT remains largely unexplored in billion-parameter and multi-billion token regimes. Furthermore, existing work relies on multi-dimensional application of scalar QAT gradient estimation and parameter updates, with no prior work exploiting the shape-gain decomposition in a QAT setting. As a result, it remains unclear how to derive a QAT rule that aligns gradient estimation and parameter updates with spherical VQ geometry.

对LLMS的量化-认识培训(QAT),使用精心选择的低位量子解析器和充足的培训预算可以保持强大的模型质量(Panferov等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年)。
虽然存在一些针对VQ的QAT工作(例如,Wang等人(2026年);Malinovskii等人(2024年)),但VQ-QAT在十亿参数和数十亿令牌制度上仍然基本上没有得到探讨. 此外,现有工作依赖于对scalar QAT梯度估计和参数更新的多维应用,之前没有工作在QAT环境中利用变形分解. 因此,仍然不清楚如何得出一个QAT规则,使梯度估计和参数更新与球形VQ几何相协调.

blocks.en:
To address this, we introduce SQuAT , a S pherical Lattice Vector Qu antization- A ware T raining
method for billion-parameter LLMs, that trains shape-gain quantizers with a factored straight-through estimator (STE), illustrated in Figure 1 . SQuAT represents each weight block using separate trainable direction and gain parameters.
In the forward pass, the direction parameter is normalized and quantized with an E 8 E_{8} -derived spherical codebook, including normalized spherical E8P12 codebook ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) or our proposed E8S construction from equal-norm lattice shells, while the gain is quantized independently with a low-bit scalar quantizer.
In the backward pass, the STE is applied separately through the direction and gain quantizers, rather than jointly through the reconstructed weight.
This factored STE induces tangent-space updates for the direction parameter, yielding spherical optimization of quantized weight directions while decoupling magnitude optimization into the gain parameter.
While spherical parameterizations themselves are well established in machine learning (e.g., DoRA ( Liu et al., 2024a ) ) and quantization, prior work has not analyzed how combining such parameterizations with STE-based quantization alters the surrogate gradients and the resulting optimization dynamics.

blocks.en: To allow practical scaling to billion-parameter models and multi-billion token training, we introduce distributed exact assignment, where workers quantize disjoint weight blocks against a shared codebook and communicate only discrete indices.
blocks.zh: 为了让实际规模达到十亿参数模型和数十亿令牌训练,我们引入了分布式的精确任务,即工人根据共享的代码表对脱节的权重块进行量化,并只交流离散指数.

blocks.en: We evaluate SQuAT on instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B models, with QAT budgets from 0.25B to 10B tokens. SQuAT improves over standard joint-STE VQ-QAT under the same quantizer and initialization, substantially improves over VQ-PTQ baselines after QAT, and remains competitive with mature scalar INT-QAT at comparable bit budgets, see Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们在指令调制LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B,Quen3-4B,以及基数Qwen3-1.7B模型上评价SQuAT,QAT的预算从0.25B到10B令牌. SQuAT在相同的量子和初始化下改进了标准联合-STE VQ-QAT,在QAT之后大大改进了VQ-PTQ基线,并在可比比特预算中与成熟的scalar INT-QAT保持竞争力,见图2。

blocks.en:
SQuAT makes the following contributions: • We propose a novel training rule for shape-gain lattice VQ-QAT, and show that this approach induces tangent-space updates on directions, yielding true Spherical VQ-QAT. • We propose a novel E 8 E_{8} -derived normalized spherical codebook which enables fractional bitwidth quantization, unlocking Pareto-optimal bit rates inaccessible to scalar methods. • We introduce a fast exact nearest-neighbor assignment implementation with fused kernels, index caching, and distributed assignment, yielding a 12.8 × \times speedup and enabling exact codebook-based VQ-QAT at billion-parameter and multi-billion-token scale. • Empirically, SQuAT improves over the Standard VQ-QAT baseline under matched quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy. • At 2.25 bpw, SQuAT outperforms INT-QAT across all models and training budgets
on WikiText2 perplexity, and achieves competitive or better MMLU and CSR, with MMLU gains of up to 7.9 % at 1B token training.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Scalar quantization
blocks.zh: 2.1 斯卡尔量化

blocks.en:
Scalar quantization maps each weight independently to a low-precision discrete set, typically using uniform integer levels ( Jacob et al., 2018 ) .
During QAT, quantization is applied in the forward pass and gradients are propagated with a straight-through estimator (STE).
As our scalar INT-QAT baseline, we use Stretched Elastic Quantization (SEQ) ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , which shifts the signed quantization grid by half a step and improves stability in low-bit regimes.
blocks.zh:
Scalar将每个重量独立地映射到一个低精度离散集,一般使用统一的整数水平(Jacob等人,2018年).
在QAT期间,在前传中应用定量法,用直通估计器(STE)传播梯度.
作为我国的Scalar INT-QAT基线,我们使用伸缩的弹性量化(SEQ)(Liu等人,2025年;Lee等人,2025年),它使已签名的量化网格移动了半步,提高了低位制度的稳定性.

blocks.en: Explicit learned or unstructured codebooks become infeasible in higher dimensions since the number of required codewords (and the cost of nearest-neighbor search) grow exponentially in dimension d d . Lattice quantization instead uses implicitly specified, highly structured codebooks with strong packing properties, retaining good rate–distortion behavior ( Gibson and Sayood, 1988 ; Conway and Sloane, 2013 ) while enabling scalable assignment procedures. Yet, VQ-QAT demands repeated nearest-neighbor (NN) assignments during training, making efficient assignment a central challenge.
blocks.zh: 由于要求的密码字数量(以及近邻搜索的成本)在维度d 上呈指数增长,明确学习到的或无结构的代码本在更高维度上变得不可行. Lattice quantization而是使用含蓄的、结构严密且具有强烈包装特性的代码簿,保留良好的比率扭曲行为(Gibson和Sayood,1988年;Conway和Sloane,2013年),同时允许可扩展的转让程序。 然而,VQ-QAT要求在培训期间重复指派近邻的任务,使高效的任务成为一项核心挑战。

blocks.en: 2.3 Shape-gain (polar) decomposition
blocks.zh: 2.3 变形(极)分解

blocks.en:
A common perspective in vector quantization is to decompose a vector into its shape (direction) and gain (magnitude) components, also known as shape-gain quantization ( Sabin and Gray, 1982 ) , which has also been successfully applied to vector quantization of LLMs ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .
For w ∈ ℝ d w\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , write w = γ ​ s , γ = ‖ w ‖ 2 ∈ ℝ + , s = w γ ∈ 𝕊 d − 1 , \displaystyle w=\gamma\,s,\qquad\gamma=\|w\|_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{+},\quad s=\frac{w}{\gamma}\in\mathbb{S}^{d-1}, (2) where γ \gamma and s s are the gain and shape, respectively.
These can now be quantized independently as w ^ = γ ^ ​ s ^ , γ ^ = Q gain ​ ( γ ) , s ^ = Q shape ​ ( s , 𝒞 ) , \hat{w}=\hat{\gamma}\,\hat{s},\qquad\hat{\gamma}=Q_{\text{gain}}(\gamma),\quad\hat{s}=Q_{\text{shape}}(s;\mathcal{C}), (3) where Q shape : 𝕊 d − 1 → 𝒞 Q_{\text{shape}}:\mathbb{S}^{d-1}\to\mathcal{C} maps each direction to a codeword in the discrete codebook 𝒞 ⊂ 𝕊 d − 1 \mathcal{C}\subset\mathbb{S}^{d-1} , with 𝕊 d − 1 = { x ∈ ℝ d ∣ ‖ x ‖ 2 = 1 } \mathbb{S}^{d-1}=\left\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d}\mid\|x\|_{2}=1\right\} , and Q gain : ℝ > 0 → 𝒞 gain Q_{\text{gain}}:\mathbb{R}_{>0}\to\mathcal{C}_{\text{gain}} is a scalar quantizer mapping each gain to a quantized gain in 𝒞 gain ⊂ ℝ > 0 \mathcal{C}_{\text{gain}}\subset\mathbb{R}_{>0} .

This separates angular error from gain error: prior VQ work shows that most representational budget should be allocated to direction, while gains can be stored with few bits ( Hamkins and Zeger, 2002 ) . Shape-gain decompositions have also been useful for optimization and adaptation, e.g., weight normalization ( Salimans and Kingma, 2016 ) and DoRA ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . However, it remains unclear how to use this geometry in QAT, where weights are repeatedly updated through STEs. In this study, we analyze how STE updates commonly used in VQ interact with shape-gain.

blocks.en:
The E 8 E_{8} lattice is a highly symmetric lattice in ℝ 8 \mathbb{R}^{8} that achieves the densest known sphere packing in eight dimensions ( Conway and Sloane, 2013 ) .
Its points are organized into norm shells, where S r = { x ∈ E 8 : ‖ x ‖ 2 2 = r } S_{r}=\{x\in E_{8}:\|x\|_{2}^{2}=r\} .
The first nonzero shells contain 240 240 , 2160 2160 , 6720 6720 , and 17520 17520 points, corresponding to the coefficients of the E 8 E_{8} theta series. Using a single shell, or a union of shells, as a codebook yields a spherical code where nearest-neighbor assignment depends on angular alignment.
Since E 8 E_{8} is infinite, finite low-bit codebooks require truncation.
We use them either in Euclidean form, retaining lattice norms, or normalized form, projecting codewords to the unit sphere for shape-gain (SG) quantization.
In our notation, non-SG variants use Euclidean form, while SG variants use the normalized spherical form.

We study two E 8 E_{8} -derived constructions.

blocks.en: 3 SQuAT : Spherical lattice VQ-QAT
blocks.zh: 3 SQuAT : 球状晶片 VQ-QAT

blocks.en: Normally, VQ-QAT maintains full-precision shadow parameters in Euclidean space while emulating low-precision inference by applying quantization only in the forward pass. For vector quantizers, the forward map is typically discrete and thus non-differentiable; gradient-based training therefore requires an explicit surrogate for backpropagation. The most common choice is the straight-through estimator (STE). In shape-gain vector quantization, however, STE can be inserted at multiple plausible locations in the computation graph, and these choices lead to different surrogate gradients and, consequently, different optimization dynamics.
blocks.zh: 通常情况下,VQ-QAT在欧几里得空间中保持全精度的阴影参数,同时通过只在前传中应用量子化来模拟低精度推论. 对于矢量量计,前向图一般是离散的,因此是不可区分的;因此,基于梯度的训练需要明确的代位来进行反射. 最常见的选择是直通估计器(STE). 然而,在形状增益向量化中,STE可以在计算图的多个可信位置插入,这些选择导致不同的代位梯度,从而导致不同的优化动态.

blocks.en:
In this work, we study how STE choices affect optimization for shape-gain vector quantization.
We analyze two natural cases: in Sec. 3.1 we consider ‘Standard VQ-QAT:’ the standard joint STE applied to the overall vector quantizer, and in Sec. 3.2 we consider our ‘Spherical VQ-QAT’ in which we apply the STE separately to the shape and gain quantizers, coupled with a spherical parameterization of the weights. We show that these choices induce distinct surrogate gradients and therefore different effective updates on the implied Euclidean weight vector. Moreover, we interpret the resulting update of Spherical VQ-QAT as a hyperspherical (Riemannian) update: a tangent-space step for the direction combined with a radial update for the gain, where normalization acts as a retraction. We adopt this update as our training rule, denoted SQuAT , and validate its benefit empirically. We emphasize that SQuAT is a training rule agnostic to the specific spherical codebook used.

blocks.en:
Exact nearest-neighbor (NN) search is the main computational bottleneck in VQ-QAT.
With N N weight blocks and a d d -dimensional codebook of size K ≈ 2 d ⋅ bpw K\approx 2^{d\cdot\mathrm{bpw}} , brute-force search costs O ⁡ ( N ​ K ​ d ) O(NKd) per quantization step.
Unlike PTQ, where search is performed once or a few times, QAT repeats assignment on every forward pass to simulate inference-time quantization.
In our implementation, each data-parallel worker computes exact NN ( 13 ) for a disjoint subset of vectors using a shared codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and only the resulting integer indices are synchronized via all-gather.
Furthermore, a new Triton kernel fuses normalization, codeword selection, and reconstruction.
We also cache quantized weights across gradient-accumulation steps, so assignment is invoked only once per optimizer step.
For E8S on LLaMA-3.2-1B, these optimizations reduce training time from 62.5 s/it for vanilla VQ-QAT to 4.9 s/it, yielding a 12.8 × \times speedup while preserving the exact nearest-neighbor assignment, see Figure 3 .
Overall, our lattice VQ-QAT implementation incurs only moderate overhead relative to scalar QAT.

与PTQ不同的是,在PTQ进行一次或几次搜索,QAT在每个前传上重复任务以模拟推论时间量化.
在我们的实施中,每个数据平行的工人用一个共享的代码簿C\mathcal{C}计算出一个不相连的矢量子集的准确NN(13),只有由此产生的整数指数通过全加法同步.
此外,一个新的Triton内核可以引导正常化、密码字选择和重建。
我们还缓存跨梯度积分步骤的量化权重,因此每个优化步骤只引用一次指派。
对于LLaMA-3.2-1B上的E8S,这些优化将培训时间从香草VQ-QAT的62.5 s/it减少到4.9 s/it,产生12.8 x\时间的加速,同时保留了最近的准确任务,见图3。
总体而言,我们实施梯队的VQ-QAT只产生相对Scalar QAT的适度间接费用。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate SQuAT on instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and base Qwen3-1.7B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
We drop the “-Instruct” and “-Instruct-2507” suffixes in the text and abbreviate the model names as L1B, L3B, Q4B, and Q1B7 in tables for brevity.
QAT fine-tunes a quantized model using DCLM-Edu ( allal et al., 2025 ) dataset with Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation ( Lee et al., 2025 ) from a frozen FP16 teacher.
We train for 0.25B–10B tokens with batch size 256 and context length 1024.
Learning rates are swept at 1B tokens and reused for longer runs.
All experiments use blockwise Hadamard rotations following QuIP# ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) .
QAT starts with weights initialized from PTQ checkpoints using a QuIP#-style GPTQ reconstruction with OmniQuant scale calibration.
Please find additional details in App. C .
blocks.zh:
我们评价SQuAT的指令调制LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B-指令(Grattafiori等人,2024年),Qune3-4B-指令2507(杨等人,2025年),以及基础的Qune3-1.7B(杨等人,2025年)。
我们删除文本中的“-指示”和“-指示-2507”后缀,在表格中缩写为L1B、L3B、Q4B和Q1B7。
QAT微调了一个使用DCLM-Edu(Allal等人,2025年)数据集的量化模型,其中Jensen–Shannon Difference(JSD)蒸馏(Lee等人,2025年)来自一个冷冻的FP16教师.
我们为0.25B – 10B 的代号进行训练,批量大小为 256 ,上下文长度为 1024.
学习率以1B令牌扫射,再利用时间较长。
所有实验都使用在QuIP#(Tseng等人,2024a)之后的阻断哈达马德旋转.
QAT从PTQ检查站初始化的重量开始,采用QuIP#风格的GBTQ重建,并使用OmniQuant比例标准.
详情请见App.C。

blocks.en:
Our primary scalar baseline, INT-QAT, is SEQ ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , which outperformed Signed quantization in preliminary experiments (App. C ).
We also compare to VQ and PTQ baselines, including QTIP and PV-Tuning where available.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要星标基线INT-QAT是SEQ(Liu等人,2025年;Lee等人,2025年),它在初步实验中的表现超过了签字量化(App.C)。
我们还比较了VQ和PTQ的基线,包括QTIP和光电图。

blocks.en:
We report WikiText2 perplexity at sequence length 4096, common-sense reasoning (CSR) and MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) accuracies.
The CSR score calculation follows QuIP# ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) and averages over six tasks.
We also report results on long generation tasks (GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) ).
All downstream evaluations use the LLM Evaluation Harness ( Gao et al., 2023 ) .
More details in App. D .
blocks.zh:
我们报告WikiText2的复杂度,序列长度4096,常识推理(CSR)和MMLU(Hendrycks et al., 2021) 敏锐.
CSR的分数计算遵循QuIP#(Tseng等人,2024a),平均超过6项任务.
我们还报告了长世代任务的结果(GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),IFEval(周等人,2023年),Long Bench(Bai等人,2024年))。
所有下游评价都使用LLM评价哈林斯(Gao等人,2023年).
详见App.D.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1: Standard vs Spherical VQ-QAT ( SQuAT ) results obtained with the same E8S shape-gain quantizer.
Standard VQ-QAT applies STE to the reconstructed block,
while Spherical VQ-QAT applies separate STEs to the shape and gain quantizers. App. E.1 extends the table to IFEval and LongBench generative tasks.
blocks.zh:
表1:标准对球体VQ-QAT(SQuAT)用相同的E8S形状增量器获得的结果.
标准VQ-QAT将STE应用于重建的块,
而球形VQ-QAT则对形状应用单独的STE,并获得量子. App.E.1将该表扩展至IFEval和LongBench基因任务.

blocks.en:
Table 1 isolates the effect of the QAT training rule. We compare two variants using the same E8S shape-gain quantizer and the same PTQ initialization: Standard VQ-QAT applies a standard STE directly to the reconstructed weight block, while Spherical VQ-QAT applies separate STEs to the quantized direction and gain.
This highlights the importance of a spherical parameterization together with separate shape and gain STEs.
Spherical VQ-QAT clearly improves WikiText2 perplexity and GSM8K accuracy across all tested models and training budgets, with GSM8K gains reaching up to 4.9 %.
CSR and MMLU improve mainly at the 1B token budget (except LLaMA-3.2-3B CSR).
Refer to App. E.1 for two more generative task results, App. E.2 for per-seed evaluations, and App. E.3 - E.6 for extra SQuAT ablations.
blocks.zh:
表1隔离了QAT训练规则的效果. 我们用相同的E8S形状增量器和相同的PTQ初始化来比较两种变体: 标准VQ-QAT对重建的重量区块直接应用标准STE,而球形VQ-QAT对量化方向和增益分别应用单独的STE.
这凸显了球形参数化与单独的形状并获得STE的重要性.
球形VQ-QAT在所有测试模型和培训预算上明显提高了WikiText2的复杂度和GSM8K的精度,GSM8K的增益达到4.9%.
公司社会责任和MMLU主要在1B符号预算上有所改进(LLaMA-3.2-3B公司社会责任除外).
关于另外两项基因任务结果,请参看App.E.1, App.E.2,每种子评价,和App. E.3 - E.6用于额外的SQuAT擦伤.

blocks.en: Table 2: QAT scaling across instruction-tuned LLaMA and Qwen models. We report WikiText2 perplexity, CSR, and MMLU as a function of QAT token budget. Missing entries indicate results that were not run or not reported under the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 表2:QAT跨教学调试LLaMA和Quen模型的缩放. 我们报告WikiText2的模糊性,CSR,和MMLU作为QAT符号预算的函数. 缺失的条目表示没有运行或没有在同一协议下报告的结果.

blocks.en: Performance from HuggingFace; training budget unspecified. Standard PV-tuning uses 1B RedPajama tokens ( Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: HuggingFace的成绩;培训预算未具体说明。 标准光电调制使用1B RedPajama令牌(Malinovskii等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Having established the training rule, Table 2 evaluates how SQuAT performs in QAT, comparing against scalar INT-QAT and strong VQ baselines.
blocks.zh: 在确定了培训规则之后,表2评价了SQuAT在QAT中如何运作,比较了Scalar INT-QAT和强VQ基线.

blocks.en:
Results show that QAT consistently improves over the corresponding PTQ initialization: at 2.25 bpw and 10B tokens, SQuAT reduces WikiText2 perplexity from 17.90 to 13.74 on LLaMA-3.2-1B, from 15.00 to 10.83 on LLaMA-3.2-3B, and from 12.52 to 9.90 on Qwen3-4B.
Downstream gains are also substantial; for example, on Qwen3-4B, MMLU improves from 54.2 after PTQ to 69.5 after QAT.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,QAT在对应的PTQ初始化上不断改进:在2.25 bpw和10B令牌上,SQuAT将WikiText2的迷惑度从LLaMA-32-1B上的17.90降至13.74,LLaMA-32-3B上的15.00降至10.83,Quen3-4B上的12.52降至9.90.
下游收益也很大;例如,在Quen3-4B上,MMLU从PTQ后的54.2提高到QAT后的69.5.

blocks.en: Compared with scalar INT-QAT, SQuAT performs favorably overall. At 2.25 bpw and 10B training tokens, it matches or surpasses INT-QAT on nearly all evaluated models and metrics, with Qwen3-4B CSR as the only exception. At 2.0 bpw, the two methods are broadly comparable, although SQuAT tends to perform better at lower training budgets ( < < 5B tokens), while INT-QAT often gains an advantage with more extensive training.
blocks.zh: 与scalar INT-QAT相比,SQuAT总体表现良好. 在2.25 bpw和10B训练令牌上,它几乎在所有被评价的模型和度量衡上匹配或超过INT-QAT,Qune3-4B CSR是唯一的例外. 在2.0 bpw时,这两种方法大致可以比较,尽管SQuAT在较低的培训预算( < 5B令牌)中往往表现更好,而INT-QAT往往通过更广泛的培训而获得优势.

blocks.en: Compared with QTIP, QUIP#, and PV-tuning, SQuAT sometimes yields higher perplexity while achieving substantially stronger downstream accuracy.
blocks.zh: 与QTIP,QUIP#,以及光电调试相比,SQuAT有时会产生更高的迷惑性,同时实现显著更强的下游精度.

blocks.en:
Compared with the most recent VQ-QAT method, LC-QAT ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , SQuAT achieves higher CSR (61.2 vs. 59.8), outperforming LC-QAT by 1.4 % on Qwen3-1.7B after 1B training tokens.
See more details in App. E.5 .
blocks.zh:
与最新的VQ-QAT方法相比,LC-QAT(Wang等人,2026年),SQuAT实现了更高的CSR(61.2对59.8),在1B训练令牌后在Qune3-1.7B上比LC-QAT成绩高1.4%.
详见App.E.5。

blocks.en:
In App. F , we compare the chi-quantile and uniform integer gain quantizers at matched bit-widths, and include FP8 (E4M3) gains as a high-precision reference.
Results shows that a fixed chi-based scale (0 gain bits) outperforms 1-bit uniform integer gain quantization, highlighting the importance of distribution-aware gain design at extreme quantization levels.
blocks.zh:
在App.F.中,我们比较了匹配位宽时的基-quantile和统一的整数增量器,并将FP8(E4M3)增量作为高精度参考.
结果显示,基于固定的基数(0增益位)比1位的统一整数增益四分位数的功率要高,凸显出分配-意识增益设计在极端四分位化水平上的重要性.

blocks.en:
Table 3 ablates two E 8 E_{8} codebooks on LLaMA-3.2-1B under matched 1B-token training.
As described in Sec. 2.4 , the lattice can be truncated either by selecting complete spherical shells (E8S) or by using structured subsets (E8P12).
Compared with E8P12, E8S improves performance both with and without shape-gain, suggesting that shell-based codebooks better match the angular assignment used by SQuAT .
At 2.25 bpw, SQuAT consistently improves results for E8P12 and E8S codebooks.
blocks.zh:
表3在1B-托肯训练下放弃了两本关于LLaMA-3.2-1B的E 8 E_{8}代码簿。
如第2.4节所述,通过选择完整的球壳(E8S)或使用结构化子集(E8P12),可以截断网纹.
与E8P12相比,E8S既能提高性能,又能提高无形状增益,说明基于 shell 的代码本更符合SQuAT 使用的角分配.
在2.25 bpw时,SQuAT持续改善E8P12和E8S编码本的成绩.

blocks.en:
Table 3: The evaluation of E8S and E8P12 codebooks with (-SG) and without shape-gain on LLaMA-3.2-1B after 1B QAT.
Bits report codebook + scale/gain bits.
blocks.zh:
表3:1B QAT之后,对E8S和E8P12编码本的评价带有(-SG),没有在LLaMA-3.2-1B上换形.
比特报告代码簿 + 比例/ 增益比特.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pareto fronts of LLaMA-3.2-1B quantized with SQuAT (E8S-SG) after 1B QAT for different gain bitwidths.
blocks.zh: 图4:LLaMA-3.2-1B的Pareto战线在1B QAT后用SQuAT(E8S-SG)进行量化,用于不同的增益比特.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the Pareto fronts of LLaMA-3.2-1B quantized with SQuAT (E8S-SG) after 1B-token QAT for different gain bitwidths. The optimal gain allocation depends on the target bit rate: 0.125 bpw performs best below 2.0 bpw, 0.25 bpw is preferred at up to 2.75 total bpw, while 0.375 gain bpw attains the best performance at 3.0 total bpw. Unlike INT-QAT, E8S supports fractional bitwidths, enabling finer-grained compression-accuracy trade-offs.
More detailed plots with downstream metrics can be found in App. E.7 .
blocks.zh:
图4显示了LLaMA-3.2-1B在1B-token QAT之后用SQuAT(E8S-SG)量化的Pareto前列,用于不同的增益位元. 最佳增益分配取决于目标比特率:0.125 bpw的性能最好在2.0 bpw以下,0.25 bpw的首选最高为2.75 bpw总和,0.375 bpw的性能最好在3.0 bpw总和. 与INT-QAT不同的是,E8S支持分数比特widths,可以进行更细的加成压缩-精确权衡.
更详细带有下游度量衡的地块可见于App. E.7.

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Post-training quantization is widely used for compressing large language models. Early approaches relied on scalar quantization with round-to-nearest strategies ( Hubara et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Dettmers et al., 2022 ; Frantar et al., 2022 ) . GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) introduced Hessian-based reconstruction. Subsequent work addressed outliers through activation-aware scaling and sparsity ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Dettmers et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) .
QuIP ( Chee et al., 2023 ) uses Hadamard rotations to make weights more amenable to quantization, while YAQA ( Tseng et al., 2026 ) improves Hessian estimation.
blocks.zh:
训练后量化法被广泛用于压缩大型语言模型. 早期方法依靠有圆至近战略的Scalar量化(Hubara等人,2021年;Wang等人,2020年;姚等人,2022年;Dettmers等人,2022年;Frantar等人,2022年). GPTQ 主题 (Frantar et al., 2023)引入了基于黑森的重建. 随后的工作通过活化感知放大和孢子处理异常值(Lin等人,2024年;Dettmers等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年)。
QuIP(Chee等人,2023年)使用哈达马德旋转使重量更容易被量化,而YAQA(Tseng等人,2026年)则改进了黑森估计.

blocks.en: Vector quantization (VQ) improves low-bit rate–distortion by exploiting correlations across parameters ( Tseng et al., 2024a ; Tseng et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Savkin et al., 2025 ; van der Ouderaa et al., 2026 ) . Representative approaches include AQLM ( Egiazarian et al., 2024 ) , which represents weights as sums of multiple codewords, and GPTVQ ( Van Baalen et al., 2024 ) , which leverages high-dimensional effects for accurate compression. However, naive VQ scales poorly due to large codebooks and expensive nearest-neighbor search.
blocks.zh: 矢量量化(VQ)通过利用跨参数的关联性来提高低位率-扭曲(Tseng等人,2024a); Tseng等人,2024b;Liu等人,2024b;Savkin等人,2025;van der Ouderaa等人,2026). 代表性方法包括代表多个密码词之和的权重的AQLM(Egiazarian et al., 2024)和利用高维效应进行准确压缩的GPTVQ(Van Baallen et al., 2024). 然而,天真的VQ尺度差,因为代码本庞大,近邻搜索费用昂贵.

blocks.en:
Lattice VQ addresses this by using structured codebooks derived from dense lattices ( Gibson and Sayood, 1988 ; Conway and Sloane, 2013 ) .
QuIP# ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) introduces an efficient finite subset of the E 8 E_{8} lattice, QTIP ( Tseng et al., 2024b ) scales VQ via trellis-based decoding, and recent work explores learning lattice structure directly ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
A few recent VQ methods further decompose weights into shape and gain to allocate bits more efficiently. Pyramid Vector Quantization (PVQ) ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ) projects vectors onto the hypersphere using an implicit lattice, while PCDVQ ( Yue et al., 2025 ) explicitly learns separate codebooks for shape and gain. These approaches primarily focus on post-training quantization.
blocks.zh:
Lattice VQ通过使用从稠密的纬度衍生出来的结构化编码本来解决这个问题(Gibson and Sayood, 1988;Conway and Sloane, 2013.).
QuIP#(Tseng等人,2024年a)引入了E 8 E_{8 } lattice, QTIP (Tseng等人,2024年b) 通过 trellis 基于解码的缩放 VQ 的高效有限子集,最近的工作探索了直接学习lattice结构(Zhang等人,2025年).
最近的一些VQ方法将权重进一步分解为形状,并获得更高效的位分配. Pyramid Vector Quantization (PVQ)(van der Ouderaa 等人, 2024年) 利用隐含的纹章将矢量投射到超层,而PCDVQ(Yue 等人, 2025年)则明确学习单独的代码表,用于形状和增益. 这些办法主要侧重于培训后量化。

blocks.en:
Quantization-aware training uses simulated quantization and straight-through estimators during training ( Jacob et al., 2018 ) . Prior work improves stability via learned clipping ( Choi et al., 2018 ) , learned step sizes ( Esser et al., 2020 ) , stochastic rounding ( Gupta et al., 2015 ) , and low-rank adaptations ( Bondarenko et al., 2024 ; Loeschcke et al., 2024 ) . Stretched Elastic Quantization ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) further improves low-bit scalar QAT, including in long-horizon LLM training.
Only limited work studies QAT with large vector or lattice codebooks.
PV-Tuning ( Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) introduces explicit reassignment steps, however they do not study longer token training.
LC-QAT ( Wang et al., 2026 ) enables up to 10B QAT through a linear-constrained vector-quantization parameterization.
Separately, constraining optimization to spherical manifolds has been shown to improve stability in large-scale LLM training, e.g., via spectral-norm sphere constraints ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .
DoRA ( Liu et al., 2024a ) similarly decomposes weights into shape and gain, revealing distinct optimization dynamics in full-precision and low-rank settings.
In contrast, we study vector-quantized QAT, where applying separate STEs to shape and gain quantizers induces spherical optimization of quantized weight directions.
blocks.zh:
量子化-意识训练在训练期间使用模拟量子化和直通量子(Jacob等人,2018年). 以往的工作通过学习剪辑(Choi等人,2018年),学习步法尺寸(Esser等人,2020年),花样轮廓(Gupta等人,2015年)和低档改编提高稳定性. (Bondarenko等人,2024年;Loeschcke等人,2024年). 伸缩 弹性量化 (Liu et al., 2025; Lee et al., 2025)进一步改进低位的scalar QAT,包括长视LLM训练.
只有有限的工作研究 QAT 带有大矢量或纹章编码本.
PV-Tuning(Malinovskii等人,2024年)引入了明确的调任步骤,但他们不学习较长的象征性培训。
LC-QAT(Wang et al., 2026)通过线性约束向量化参数化,可以实现最高10B的QAT.
另外,通过光谱规范球面限制等手段,限制优化球面多面体,可以提高大规模LLM训练的稳定性(Xie等人,2026年)。
DoRA(Liu等人,2024a)类似地将权重分解为形状和增益,揭示了在全精度和低阶环境下的显著优化动态.
相比之下,我们研究了矢量量化QAT,其中应用单独的STE来形状和获得量子,诱导对量子化重量方向的球面优化.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion, future work, and limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论、今后的工作和限制

blocks.en:
This work studies lattice VQ-QAT at billion-parameter scale and multi-billion-token horizons.
With shape-gain parameterization and spherical E 8 E_{8} codebooks, SQuAT substantially improves over VQ-PTQ baselines and a standard joint-STE VQ-QAT baseline under the same quantizer and initialization.
blocks.zh:
这项工作以10亿参数的尺度和数以亿计的地平线研究Lattice VQ-QAT.
有了形状增益参数化和球形的E 8 E_{8}代码簿,SQuAT比VQ-PTQ基线和同一量子和初始化下的标准联合-STE VQ-QAT基线大有改进.

blocks.en:
SQuAT outperforms INT-QAT at 2.25 bpw across almost all models, metrics, and QAT token budgets, while remaining competitive at 2.0 bpw. Mature INT-QAT benefits from a wide range of stabilization techniques, whereas VQ-QAT remains relatively underexplored.
To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of exact nearest-neighbor VQ-QAT at billion-parameter and multi-billion-token scale, enabled by an efficient distributed assignment implementation.
Future work should explore VQ-specific training improvements, including adaptations of INT-QAT techniques such as clipping.
blocks.zh:
SQuAT以2.25 bpw的优于INT-QAT,覆盖几乎所有的模型,度量衡,和QAT符号预算,同时保持2.0 bpw的竞争力. Mature INT-QAT受益于各种稳定技术,而VQ-QAT的开发程度相对较低。
据我们所知,这是通过高效的分布式分配任务执行,首次以10亿参数和数十亿吨比例证明最近的VQ-QAT。
今后的工作应探讨针对VQ的培训改进,包括适应INT-QAT技术,如剪接技术。

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to E8P12 and E8S codebooks, up to 4B models, and budgets up to 10B tokens. 7B+ models, broader architectures, and higher-bit hierarchical schemes remain future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价仅限于E8P12和E8S编码本,最多4B模型,预算最多10B令牌. 7B+模型,更广泛的架构,以及更高位的等级计划仍然是未来的工作.

blocks.en:
Tseng et al. (2024a) demonstrate the hardware efficiency of the E8P12 codebook through a custom CUDA implementation. However, E8P12 is limited to a fixed 2.0 bpw codebook rate. In contrast, E8S enables flexible rate allocation, but currently lacks an efficient dequantizer.
Recent work on Leech-lattice VQ ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2026 ) suggests that fast dequantization may also be achievable for spherical lattice codebooks, making efficient E8S implementations a promising direction.
blocks.zh:
Tseng et al. (2024a)通过定制的CUDA执行,演示了E8P12编码本的硬件效率. 然而,E8P12仅限于固定的2.0 bpw编码本率. 相比之下,E8S则能够灵活分配利率,但目前缺乏高效的定值器.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SQuAT , a shape-gain lattice VQ-QAT method for low-bit LLM compression. SQuAT decomposes each weight block into a normalized direction (shape) and scalar gain, quantizes shape with an E 8 E_{8} -derived spherical lattice codebook, quantizes gains separately, and applies separate STEs through the two quantizers.
This induces spherical optimization of quantized weight directions, and our ablations show that it improves over a standard VQ STE under the same quantizer and PTQ initialization.
To make long-horizon lattice VQ-QAT practical, we introduced distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment for shared lattice codebooks, reducing training time from 62.5 s/it to 4.9 s/it.
Across LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B and Qwen3-4B/1.7B models, QAT with SQuAT substantially improves performance over VQ-PTQ baselines and a standard joint-STE VQ-QAT baseline, while remaining competitive with scalar INT-QAT at comparable bit budgets.
Our ablations further show the importance of chi-based gain quantization, gain bit rate selection, and shadow-weight updates.

blocks.en:
For PTQ initialization, we follow the QuIP# setup ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) : a GPTQ-style column-wise reconstruction with Hessian-based error propagation is used to quantize pretrained weights.

For non-shape-gain models at exactly 2 bpw, we apply channel-wise post-scaling and tune Hadamard rotations.
We omit auxiliary storage overheads below 0.01 bpw from reported bit budgets; for example, one BF16 scale per channel adds approximately 16 / 2048 ≈ 0.008 16/2048\approx 0.008 bpw for hidden dimension 2048.

As described in Sec. 3.2 , the explicit-gain formulation used by SQuAT introduces a learnable per-block gain parameter γ b \gamma_{b} , which is optimized and quantized independently and applied after shape quantization.

blocks.en:
Table 10 isolates the contribution of each component of SQuAT :
the spherical parameterization and the factored STE.
Replacing Standard VQ-QAT’s joint STE with a factored STE while keeping Euclidean shadow weights
(Sec. B.2 ) yields inconsistent results—sometimes marginally better,
sometimes worse than Standard VQ-QAT, with no clear trend across models or metrics.
This is consistent with the analysis in Sec. B.2 : the factored STE in
Euclidean space does induce a tangential–radial decomposition of the gradient update,
but since the update is applied in flat Euclidean space without a retraction step,
it does not correspond to a principled Riemannian update and the induced structure
does not reliably translate into better optimization.
blocks.zh:
表10列出SQuAT每个部分的贡献:
球形参数化和因子化的STE。
将标准 VQ- QAT 的 联合STE 替换为有系数的 STE , 同时保留 Euclidean 阴影权重
(第B.2节)结果不一致,有时稍好一些,
有时比标准VQ-QAT更糟糕,没有跨模型或度量标准的明确趋势.
这与Sec.B.2中的分析是一致的:
欧几利得空间确实会诱导梯度更新的微小-射线分解,
但是由于更新被应用在平坦的欧几利得空间 没有退缩步骤,
它不符合有原则的里曼式更新和诱导结构
不可靠地转化为更好的优化。

blocks.en:
By contrast, Spherical VQ-QAT ( SQuAT ) consistently improves over Standard VQ-QAT across all three
models and all three metrics except Llama-3.2-3B CSR.
In Spherical VQ-QAT, the factored STE is applied within the spherical parameterization,
so the shape update is automatically projected onto the tangent space and followed by
retraction via renormalization.
We therefore conclude that neither component alone is sufficient:
the spherical parameterization provides the geometric structure for a principled
tangent-step plus retraction update, while the factored STE ensures the update
is consistent with the quantized forward quantities ( s ^ , γ ^ ) (\hat{s},\hat{\gamma}) seen during training.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,球形VQ-QAT(SQuAT)在所有三个方面都比标准VQ-QAT不断改进.
除了Llama-3.2-3B CSR之外,模型和所有三个度量衡。
在球形VQ-QAT中,因子STE在球形参数化范围内应用,
因此形状更新会自动投射到切换空间,然后
通过恢复正常化进行收回。
因此,我们的结论是,仅靠这两个部分是不够的:
球形参数化提供了原则性的几何结构
切换步骤加还原更新,而要素化的STE确保更新
与训练时看到的量化前方数量(s ^, γ ^)(\hat{s},\hat\gamma})一致。

blocks.en:
Table 11 compares SQuAT against LC-QAT on Qwen3-1.7B. Since the original LC-QAT paper reports only the six CSR task accuracies for its 1B-token checkpoint, PPL and MMLU values are unavailable for direct comparison. Nevertheless, after 1B training tokens, SQuAT achieves higher CSR (61.2 vs. 59.8), outperforming LC-QAT by 1.4 %.
These results demonstrate that exact codebook-based VQ-QAT can match or exceed the performance of recent scalable VQ-QAT approaches despite directly optimizing discrete codeword assignments.
blocks.zh:
表11比较了SQuAT和LC-QAT在Qune3-1.7B上的对比. 由于最初的LC-QAT文件只报告其1B-token检查站的6个CSR任务速率,PPL和MMLU值无法直接比较. 尽管如此,在1B训练令牌之后,SQuAT实现了更高的CSR(61.2对59.8),比LC-QAT的成绩高1.4%.
这些结果表明,精确的基于代码的VQ-QAT可以匹配或超过近期可扩展的VQ-QAT方法的性能,尽管直接优化了离散的代码任务.

blocks.en: E.6 Hadamard rotations
blocks.zh: E.6 哈达马德轮值

blocks.en: Table 12: Ablation of Hadamard rotations with and without shape-gain on LLaMA-3.2-1B (E8S-SG) after 1B QAT.
blocks.zh: 表12:在1B QAT之后,在LLaMA-3.2-1B(E8S-SG)上进行和不进行形状增益的哈达马德旋转.

blocks.en: Table 13: Ablation of Hadamard rotations with and without shape-gain on LLaMA-3.2-1B (E8P12-SG) after 1B QAT.
blocks.zh: 表13:在1B QAT之后,Hadamard旋转在LLaMA-3.2-1B(E8P12-SG)上有无增益形状。

blocks.en: Tables 12 and 13 study the effect of blockwise Hadamard rotations after 1B-token QAT on LLaMA-3.2-1B. Across all configurations, Hadamard rotations consistently improve performance. Removing rotations increases perplexity by 0.42–1.65 points and decreases MMLU by 1.9–3.8 points, indicating that input mixing remains beneficial even after QAT.
blocks.zh: 表12和表13研究了1B-token QAT后断块旋转对LLaMA-3.2-1B的影响. 在所有布局中,哈达马德的轮换不断提高性能. 取消旋转会增加0.42–1.65分,使MMLU减少1.9–3.8分,表明即使在QAT之后,输入混合仍然有益.

blocks.en: At the same time, shape-gain provides substantial gains both with and without Hadamard rotations. For example, in the E8S-based setting at 2.25 bpw, SQuAT improves perplexity from 14.53 to 13.85 and MMLU from 37.0 to 40.3 when rotations are enabled. Importantly, the advantage persists even when rotations are removed, where SQuAT achieves 14.89 perplexity and 36.5 MMLU compared to 15.26 and 33.2 without shape-gain. Similar trends are observed for E8P12-based SQuAT . These results suggest that Hadamard rotations and shape-gain offer complementary benefits: Hadamard improves quantization by equalizing statistics, while shape-gain consistently improves accuracy regardless of whether rotations are present.
blocks.zh: 同时,无论有无哈达马德轮值,形状增益都带来巨大收益。 例如,在2.25 bpw的基于E8S的设置中,SQuAT在允许旋转时,提高通性从14.53到13.85,MMLU从37.0到40.3. 重要的是,即使在取消轮换时,这种优势依然存在,因为SQuAT在轮换方面达到14.89个复杂度和36.5个MMLU,而15.26个和33.2个则不增加形状。 以E8P12为基础的SQuAT也有类似趋势。 这些结果表明,哈达马德轮转和换形可提供互补的好处: 哈达马尔德通过平衡统计来改进定量,而形状增益则无论是否存在旋转,始终提高准确性.

blocks.en:
While Hadamard rotations are beneficial, unfused rotations introduce additional latency overhead and may be unsupported on some deployment targets.
Nevertheless, shape-gain retains most of its benefit even without Hadamard rotations, making E8P12-based SQuAT particularly attractive for deployment.
blocks.zh:
虽然哈达马德的轮调是有益的,但未使用的轮调带来了额外的延迟间接费用,在一些部署目标上可能得不到支持。
然而,即使没有哈达马德的轮换,形状增益仍保留了大部分好处,使得基于E8P12的SQuAT特别有部署吸引力.

blocks.en:
This quantizer is distribution-agnostic and simple to implement,
but we find it less effective than the chi-quantile quantizer
at very low bit-widths, particularly when b γ ≤ 2 b_{\gamma}\leq 2 .
Figure 7 shows results for a 2-bit E8P12 codebook.
At very low precision (1–2 gain bits, corresponding to ∼ 0.125 − 0.25 \sim 0.125-0.25 additional bpw), chi-quantile gains consistently outperform uniform integer quantization.
As gain precision increases, the gap narrows and both methods approach FP8 performance.
Notably, a fixed chi-based scale (zero gain bits) outperforms 1-bit uniform integer gain quantization, highlighting the importance of distribution-aware gain design in the extremely low-bit regime.
We therefore adopt chi-quantile gain quantization as the default for low-bit SQuAT .
